description: This Java class defines a log filter named MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements the LogNode interface. Its purpose is to filter log messages so that only the message content is passed downstream, omitting other metadata like tags or priorities. It can be used in logging chains to display minimal log output, such as in on-screen logs.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter class implementing LogNode that filters logs to only pass message content.
